question: ______ won the Japanese Formula 1 Grand Prix 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __Max Verstappen.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Red Bull's Max Verstappen on** 9th Oct 2022 won the Japanese F1 Grand Prix to become world champion for the second successive season.**
 
• Red Bull' Sergio Perez & Ferrari's Charles Leclerc came at the 2nd and 3rd positions respectively.
 
• It was Verstappen's maiden Japanese GP win.
 
• Earlier, Sergio Perez had won the Singapore F1 Grand Prix on 2nd Oct 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• List of 2022 F1 Race Winners:

 
 
• Singapore F1 Grand Prix: Sergio Perez
 
• Dutch Formula 1 Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• Belgian Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• Hungarian Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• Bahrain Grand Prix: Charles Leclerc (Ferrari-Monaco)
 
• Saudi Arabian Grand Prix: Max Verstappen (Red Bull – Netherlands);
 
• Australian Grand Prix: Charles Leclerc (Ferrari-Monaco).
 
• Azerbaijan Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• Canadian Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• Spanish Grand Prix: Max Verstappen
 
• British Grand Prix: Carlos Sainz
 
• Austrian F1 Grand Prix: Charles Leclerc
